newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Development Fin Corp renamed DFCC Bank.
newsitem.headline: Development Fin Corp renamed DFCC Bank.

text.p: Sri Lanka's Development Finance Corp of Ceylon (DFCC) said on Wednesday it had changed its name to DFCC Bank.

DFCC general manager and chief executive Moksevi Prelis told Reuters the institution had been redesignated a specialist bank under a new parliamentary act, which would allow it to invest in ventures in which the government held a majority stake.

"For the last 41 years DFCC was exclusively confined to only the private sector -- namely where government ownership was less than 50 percent. But that clause has now been lifted," Prelis said in an interview.

Prelis said the new specialist bank status would also remove limits on the size of government financial guarantees it could be granted. Under its previous status, DFCC was limited to government guarantees of three billion rupees.

DFCC Bank would continue to offer fixed deposits to its customers and undertake a wide range of other banking and finance activities, but it would still not be able to offer current accounts, he said.
"Only commercial banks can take demand deposits," he said.
